description:
modules/traegerview — GET /traeger/schools/key-date-counts (#4673): the
Träger row and the school IDs of the Träger, the school rows, then at
Organisation & Tenancy the Träger row again (the owner checks the Träger
itself) and the captured Stichtagszahlen of all its schools, in one
administrative transaction. Flat in the number of schools.
